spots.name: Bellingham Technical College Refridgerated Sign
spots.blurb: You've reached Bellingham Technical College Refridgerated Sign, a mural. This Mural spells out "Bellingham Technical College". The sign letters are the evaporator portion of a refrigeration system maintained by the HVAC department at BTC . The letters are cold to touch, and moisture condenses on it and makes snow.
